supporting_labs.scope: Offline audit-policy foundations; full live chapter6 is infrastructure/07-apiserver-security step1.

validation.authoring: Every chapter is mapped to actual indexed hands-on steps with setup, solution and verifier.
validation.hosted: Root integration agent is performing Chrome hosted testing. Do not infer hosted success from authored coverage.
validation.infrastructure: See research/infrastructure-full-lab-map.json for real local infrastructure test evidence.
limitations: Host groups require a disposable Linux VM and network access to upstream registries and package servers.
kube-bench0.16.0 explicitly uses the supplied cis-1.12 profile for two applicable controls; upstream does not automatically map hosted Kubernetes1.36.
Falco requires kernel BTF and usable modern eBPF; AppArmor requires an enabled host LSM.
No canned scan results, fabricated Falco events, mock audit records or fake runtimes are accepted as completion.

local_environment.isolation: Dedicated kind cluster; Linux groups run inside its disposable node; default user context untouched.
